$Comment: What a player sees and hears the instant a quest's last objective is met and it pays out on
the spot. A quest that has to be collected somewhere is the separate quest.parked moment.
This is the library's own neutral default, so a bare server gets a notice and a jingle out of
the box. A mod that ships a file with this same name in its own pack replaces it (a pack that
lists this library as a dependency loads after it), and a server owner can do the same from
the owner layer. Override the whole file rather than editing this one.
The moment carries 'quest' (its id), 'title' (its name, already in the reader's language),
'parked' (false here) and, for a quest collected somewhere in particular, 'turnIn' (the kind
of place: character or accept_site). 'player' is always the name of who finished it.
Key is a line from a .lang file; Args names which of those values fill its blanks, in order.
Sound is any SoundEvent id, played at the player's own position. Delete either group in your
override to drop that half; add a Broadcast group to tell the whole server.
Tone colours the whole notification, frame and words together - gold Reward here, because a
quest paying out is a payout. The rewards it pays list themselves as rows under the headline
on the in-page toast; the Toast's Rows group switches that off or caps how many show.
